name: DOT Diagrams
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Rejects unknown preset names and applies diagram size limits to SVG and PNG export.
Wikilink nodes now get the node defaults of the graph.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
An unknown preset name now falls back to the theme colors with a message, and the size limits now apply to SVG and PNG exports too.
Nodes made from wikilinks now use the graph's default node style.
tip: Add '// engine: neato' to a dot block to use a spring layout.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. DOT Diagrams is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
